notes: Equinix's first xScale campus in the Hampton area, about 40 miles from downtown Atlanta; Equinix said in Aug 2025 the site was being graded. Sold into the xScale JV (AMER 3) in Jan 2026 for $459M per Equinix 10-Q. Exact parcel not confirmed: may be the same land as Henderson Farms (ga-henry-southeast-property-henderson-farms) or Hampton Technology Park (ga-henry-hampton-technology-park). Hampton overlap check (2026-10-15), UNRESOLVED. For Equinix = Henderson Farms: both use Central Georgia EMC (Equinix deal per Data Centre Magazine, Aug 2026; Henderson Farms per DRI #4680) and both surfaced around March 2025. Against: trackers place Equinix at 1000 Site Parkway, about 3.6 miles from Henderson Farms (GA-20 W, parcel 039-01015000); sizes differ (Equinix reported 4 buildings and 240 MW vs 3 x 195,000 sq ft and 200 MW); the Henderson Farms DRI was filed in March 2026 for Southeast Property Holdings, after Equinix had sold its campus into the xScale JV (Jan 2026). Hampton Technology Park (Lower Woolsey Road, Georgia Power, 1,500 MW, filed Feb 2026) is probably a third, separate campus. A Henry County parcel owner lookup would settle it. Pass 3 (2026-10-15): DRI forms re-read: Hampton Technology Park is parcels 003-01042003 and 003-01042000 (DRI #4624); Henderson Farms data center is parcel 039-01015000 on GA-20 W (DRI #4680). Those two are different land, so they are separate campuses. Equinix's parcel is still unknown (only trackers give 1000 Site Parkway); neither DRI names Equinix. No merge.

name: Microsoft Rome data center campus (Huffaker Road, Project Firecracker)

tax_break.value: 12-year partial property tax abatement on buildings and equipment via Rome-Floyd County Development Authority revenue bonds

news.title: Microsoft to invest $1 billion in data center in Floyd County
Microsoft to develop 350-acre data center campus in Rome, Georgia

notes: Announced at a Rome-Floyd County Development Authority meeting Oct 30, 2023: 347 acres on Huffaker Road east of Fouche Gap Road, land at $40,000/acre, target go-live 2027-2028. No construction or permit record found as of this check.

name: Nixon Technology Center data center campus (Four H Club Road)
owner: 3 G Investments, LLC (developer); The Nixon Trusts (land)

power_mw.unit: MW peak connected load (Georgia Power, DRI filing)

cooling_type.value: Closed loop (filing says no MGD water use)

local_tax_paid.unit: USD per year (estimated local tax revenue, DRI filing)

notes: DRI #4853 filed by Augusta-Richmond County Oct 12, 2026: 3.34M sq ft data center campus at 1550 and 1538 Four H Club Road and 3806 Mike Padgett Hwy, southeast Richmond County; completion 2028-2029. Developer based in Woodbridge, VA. Not the QTS Augusta site (Gordon Highway/Powell Road, ga-richmond-qts-augusta). Lat/lng from the filing.

name: T5 ATL III data center campus (Douglas Hill Road area)

water_use.unit: gallons per day (Douglasville-Douglas County WSA, DRI filing)

notes: DRI #3747: four 2-story data center buildings, 1.6M sq ft, on an 80-acre tract bounded by Douglas Hill Road; phase 1 due April 2024, all by Oct 2025. Trackers list it as under construction with a later timeline; no official or news confirmation of construction found, so stage stays 'announced'. Separate from T5 ATL IV (Coweta/Fulton records). About 1.2 km north of the Rock House Road DRI site (1971 Rock House Road, ga-douglas-rock-house-road; different developer, Taylor Mathis), so a neighbor, not the same filing. Lat/lng from the DRI coordinates.

name: Microsoft Palmetto data center (Williams Road)

investment_usd.unit: USD per building (about $500/sq ft, DRI filing)

water_use.unit: gallons per day peak (City of Atlanta water, DRI filing)

local_tax_paid.unit: USD per year average over 10 years for one building (DRI estimate)

notes: DRI #3576 (Jan 2022): site clearing and grading for a future Microsoft data center at 0 Williams Road, Palmetto. Microsoft's local page says construction began April 2024 (Turner Construction) with completion estimated by early October 2025 (https://local.microsoft.com/blog/palmetto-datacenter-construction-update/, mid-2024). Whether it is now running is not confirmed. An earlier Palmetto filing 'Microsoft CCO06 Data Center' (DRI #3463, 2021) was terminated. Separate from Microsoft Union City ATL50 (ga-fulton-microsoft-union-city). Lat/lng from the DRI coordinates.

name: DataBank ATL4 (Selig Drive, South Fulton)

power_mw.unit: MW critical IT load

notes: 200 Selig Dr SW (company page: 212,710 IT sq ft, 40 MW). DataBank bought the 18-acre site with an existing building in May 2022 (reported $10.9M) and broke ground on ATL4 in May 2023 (DCD, Nov 1, 2023: https://datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/databank-acquires-100-acres-in-atlanta-georgia-for-120mw-data-enter-campus). The company page lists onsite carriers, which suggests it may now be open, but no dated opening source was found, so stage is 'building'. Lat/lng geocoded from the address.

name: DataBank Lithia Springs campus (ATL5 and ATL6, Bakers Ferry Road)

power_mw.unit: MW critical IT (ATL5 48 MW + ATL6 72 MW)

utility.value: Georgia Power (180 MW on-site substation planned)

notes: 4764 Bakers Ferry Rd SW, South Fulton (company page says the campus 'will host' ATL5 and ATL6, 400,200 IT sq ft). Despite the 'Lithia Springs' name the address geocodes to Fulton County, not Douglas. Land (95 acres) bought Nov 2023, within a mile of ATL4; two multi-story buildings up to 1M gross sq ft; no timeline given (DCD). Lat/lng geocoded from the address.

name: Flexential Douglasville campus (Atlanta - Douglasville 1 and 2)

power_mw.unit: MW critical load (22.5 + 36)

notes: Douglasville 1 at 1700 N. River Road: 205,000+ sq ft, 22.5 MW critical power (https://www.flexential.com/data-centers/ga/atlanta/douglasville-data-center); Douglasville 2 at 1750 N. River Road: 358,000 sq ft, 36 MW critical load (https://www.flexential.com/data-centers/ga/atlanta/douglasville-2-data-center). Next-door buildings, one record. Douglasville 2 running status not stated on its page.

name: H5 Data Centers Atlanta (345 Courtland Street NE)
notes: 345 Courtland St. NE, downtown Atlanta; 110,000 sq ft data center and carrier hotel, site of Level 3's Atlanta Gateway (https://h5datacenters.com/atlanta-data-center.html). Size test: no MW published, so it counts as a large colocation campus on floor area (100,000+ sq ft rule, pass 3).

name: Centersquare Lithia Springs ATL1

power_mw.unit: MW utility power

notes: Lithia Springs ATL1: 102,421 sq ft raised floor, 81.5 MW utility power (https://www.csquare.com/data-centers/atlanta). Centersquare's page gives the town but no street address, so no coordinates, and the county is inferred from the town name only (confirm with the address). 'Utility power' is the site's utility service, not IT load; pass 3 rule: a Centersquare site counts when utility power is 20 MW+ and its town sits in one county.

name: Microsoft East Point datacenter campus (Ben Hill Road)

official_statements.text: Thank you for your cooperation and patience as we continue construction on the buildout of the datacenter campus.

notes: Microsoft local page: two datacenter buildings and a substation on six parcels on Ben Hill Road, East Point; 131.6 acres combined, 84.6 developed; project timing 2023-2026; 'we continue construction on the buildout of the datacenter campus.' County not named by Microsoft; East Point is in Fulton County. Microsoft's Atlanta page says it is building datacenters in Douglasville, Palmetto and East Point.

name: Microsoft Douglasville datacenters
